Name: Alex's Pumpkin Carving (Pumpkin Patch Add-on)
Author: xBrince
Description:
[size=5][b]Alex's Pumpkin Carving[/b][/size]
[i]Carve your own face into a giant pumpkin. One pixel at a time. In the game.[/i]

[b][color=#ff9900]AI DISCLOSURE:[/color] This mod is 100% AI-generated.[/b] Every sprite, every line of code and all of the text was made by an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic) from my ideas and direction. I did not draw the art or hand-write the code. Nothing from the base game or from other mods is included in the download. Feel free to use parts of it in your own work (see [b]Permissions[/b] below), just don't claim you made the assets or code yourself.

[line]

[size=4][b]What it does[/b][/size]
Craft a [b]Carving Pumpkin[/b] from an Atlantic Giant (from [url=PASTE_LINK_TO_PUMPKIN_PATCH_PAGE]Alex's Pumpkin Patch[/url]) and a torch, place it, point at it and press [b]C[/b]. A carving screen opens with your pumpkin drawn big. Click or drag to cut away the rind, right-click to put it back. The stem and outline stay put; everything else is yours. At night your face glows like a candle.

[list]
[*][b]Pixel-by-pixel carving[/b] on a 42 x 40 grid, with brush sizes 1 to 5, a fill tool, a mirror mode that draws both sides of the face at once, and a night preview so you can see how the glow will look.[/*]
[*][b]Undo and redo[/b] (80 steps), flip, clear, and a Revert button that takes you back to how the pumpkin was when you opened the screen. Every stroke is saved as you let go, so you can never lose your work by closing the screen.[/*]
[*][b]12 ready-made faces[/b] (Classic, Happy, Wink, Surprised, Angry, Cat, Bat, Skull, Ooh, Sleepy, Lovestruck, Monster) to stamp on and change however you like.[/*]
[*][b]Candle glow[/b] that follows the size of your face, with a soft flicker and halo. Off / Faint / Dim / Bright, and you choose how many separate cut-outs (1 to 8, or all) give off real light.[/*]
[*][b]Optional: Alex's String Lights[/b] (0.9.0 or newer). A Light tool appears; cut-outs you cut with it are lit by String Lights in its colours and patterns (chase, twinkle, fire...), and the pattern editor works on your pumpkin like on any other string. Mix both on one face: a candle-lit smile with rainbow eyes.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or newer and [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][b]Alex's Pumpkin Patch[/b] (required, the pumpkin is made from its Atlantic Giant)[/*]
[*]Optional: [url=PASTE_LINK_TO_STRING_LIGHTS_PAGE]Alex's String Lights[/url] 0.9.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Get an Atlantic Giant. The first time one is in your pack you learn the Carving Pumpkin recipe.[/*]
[*]Craft it with 1 torch and place it anywhere.[/*]
[*]Stand near it and press C while pointing at it (or while holding it).[/*]
[*]Draw. Left-click cuts, right-click puts the rind back. Hover over any button for a tip. Hotkeys: C carve, L light, F fill, M mirror, N night, G grid, 1-5 brush size, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo / redo.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
In [b]config.json[/b] (created on first launch) or Generic Mod Config Menu: carve key, candle glow, shining cut-outs (1 to 8 or All), halos, and whether to use String Lights.

[size=4][b]Compatibility and save safety[/b][/size]
Adds one furniture item and one crafting recipe and changes nothing else. The face is stored as one short line of text on the furniture itself, nothing else is added to your save. Pick carved pumpkins up before removing the mod. Built for single player; multiplayer is untested.

[size=4][b]Permissions[/b][/size]
Because this mod is entirely AI-generated, I want it to stay honest and shareable. You are welcome to use, edit, translate or remix any part of it in your own mods, as long as you:
[list=1]
[*]Do [b]not[/b] claim you created the assets or code yourself, and say plainly that they are AI-generated.[/*]
[*]Credit it: "Alex's Pumpkin Carving by Alex (AI-generated with Claude)" with a link back to this page.[/*]
[*]Do not re-upload the unmodified mod, and do not sell it or put it behind a paywall.[/*]
[/list]The full terms are in [b]LICENSE.txt[/b] in the download.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Direction, ideas, testing and publishing: Alex. Art, code and text: Claude (Anthropic), an AI assistant. Thanks to the SMAPI and Generic Mod Config Menu authors, whose tools make this kind of mod possible.
